title: Some changes to the "data sources" API.
description:
Split "get_data_source_tvb_by_name()" into a new
"get_data_source_by_name()" routine and the existing
"get_data_source_tvb()" routine.

Add a new "set_data_source_name()" to change the data source name.

Rename "get_data_source_name()" to "get_data_source_description()", as
it doesn't just return the name.

notes.body: enabled an automatic merge when all merge checks for e38b1726bde59a74e1b92c7479eb4cb9456971ab pass

commits_data.message:
Some changes to the "data sources" API.

Split "get_data_source_tvb_by_name()" into a new
"get_data_source_by_name()" routine and the existing
"get_data_source_tvb()" routine.

Add a new "set_data_source_name()" to change the data source name.

Rename "get_data_source_name()" to "get_data_source_description()", as
it doesn't just return the name.
